text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF). The combination of a dry cough, progressive exertional dyspnea, restrictive lung pattern on PFTs, and bilateral interstitial infiltrates on the HRCT is classic for this condition. Given your normal autoimmune workup and lack of occupational exposure, idiopathic is the most likely cause.
